assumptions: A left-hand symbol with a larger text block is the proposed horizontal arrangement for the 180px shop header.

brand_strategy.positioning: An independent notebook and stationery brand for adult professionals and creators who enjoy organizing thoughts on paper and keeping useful objects for a long time.
brand_strategy.audience_need: Recognize considered, comfortable everyday stationery through a clear shop-header name and a simple mark suitable for a notebook packaging label.
brand_strategy.brand_promise: Attentive, comfortable tools for sustained paper use; this identity does not claim tested durability or product superiority.
brand_strategy.distinctive_principle: An offset paper-layer contour and one open fold interval give the compact symbol a material starting point without stock notebook or pen imagery; the calm name remains the primary read.
brand_strategy.typography: Exact Folio in a medium low-contrast humanist sans appearance: capital F, lowercase olio, open o counters, distinct l, softened terminals and steady optical spacing, without vintage or hotel-style hairlines.
brand_strategy.color_roles: Muted clay #A76148 is limited to the compact paper-layer symbol; graphite #333B39 carries the entire name. Opaque white #FFFFFF fills the exterior and the open fold interval.
